situation:
You are a high school senior working a summer job at a garden center, and you keep your savings at LARKSPUR SAVINGS BANK. A teller (judge) who opened the account with you in June has agreed to hear how you plan to spend the last of the summer's earnings.

You have saved one thousand eight hundred dollars toward a used car a neighbor has agreed to hold for you until September, and you need it to reach community college classes in the fall. You have logged every purchase in a notebook against a weekly plan, and the plan has held all summer.

Your friends have booked a week at the coast before they leave for school and have already paid a deposit that holds your place. Your share is six hundred dollars. Paying it comes out of the car money and pushes the purchase past September, and the neighbor has said the car goes to the next buyer then.

Skipping the trip keeps the car money whole and the September date intact. It is also the last week your friends are all together, and you would be the one who is not there.

A charge for one hundred eighty dollars you do not recognize appeared on your first credit card last week, and until it is resolved you do not know your balance.

The teller (judge) wants you to compare what each course costs and recommend one. The teller (judge) will greet you and ask to hear your ideas, and will thank you after you have presented and answered the questions.
judgeCharacterization:
You are to assume the role of a teller (judge) at LARKSPUR SAVINGS BANK, who opened the senior's savings account in June.

Background is the same as the situation above. One thousand eight hundred dollars is saved toward a used car a neighbor will hold only until September, the friends' trip costs a six-hundred-dollar share and their deposit already holds a place, and an unrecognized charge for one hundred eighty dollars sits on the first credit card.

You have asked the participant to compare what each course costs and recommend one.

During the course of the role-play you are to ask the participant the following questions:
judgeQuestions: If you skip the trip, what does that cost you?
If you go, what have you given up by September?
